selection_rule: Manual review of month-specific narrative on pages 3-8. Keep only explicitly named whole federal subjects with an unambiguous temperature or precipitation direction relative to climate normal. Exclude federal districts, partial subjects, map-only information, and comparisons with the previous year.
units: Direction +1/-1 for temperature or precipitation relative to climate normal; no degrees, millimeters or probability assigned to each region.
availability: Conservative next day after dated official release; attachment was linked from release, but 2023/2024 historical PDF vintages were not archived independently.
missing: No explicit whole-region claim means unknown, not normal weather.
scope: Regional context only; not proof that every municipality experienced the stated anomaly.
model_status: Coverage and point-in-time alignment only; not fitted to spending or used in primary model selection.
comparison_baseline: Source climate normal: reference years not explicitly identified in these warm-season PDFs. Kept separate from climate-normal 1991-2020 claims in heating bulletins.
